scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run start -w @footroll/desktop
scripts.desktop:package: npm run build && npm run package -w @footroll/desktop
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && npm run ios:sync -w @footroll/simulator
scripts.format: prettier --write simulator/src simulator/*.ts simulator/index.html packages/engine/src desktop/main.cjs *.json */package.json packages/*/package.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check simulator/src simulator/*.ts simulator/index.html packages/engine/src desktop/main.cjs *.json */package.json packages/*/package.json
